chunks: Thus do We keep opponents among the sinners for every apostle; yet your Lord is sufficient as a guide and helper.
ai.seo_question: Who are the enemies appointed for every prophet according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the inevitability of opposition faced by all prophets, framing it not as a failure but as a divine mechanism to distinguish the sincere from the hypocritical. It reassures the faithful that despite the hostility of the 'mujrimin' (criminals/sinners), Allah’s guidance and support are absolute, a theme particularly resonant with the struggles of the Ahl al-Bayt against their adversaries.
